prompts.name: mmh-kbeauty
prompts.prompt: Create an authentic UGC-style selfie of a beautiful Korean woman around 25 years old, taken on a front phone camera at arm's length. Flawless, healthy, dewy 'glass-skin' complexion with a natural luminous glow — even tone, no heavy makeup, fresh and bare-skin looking. Soft natural window light at home, relatable everyday setting (bedroom or bathroom) softly blurred behind her. Slight casual phone-camera feel, candid and real, gentle natural smile, looking into the lens. Focus entirely on her radiant skin and the natural, trustworthy UGC mood — not a polished studio ad.
